summary: dxr -remove-unused-functions -remove-unused-globals -E ps_main removes a struct declaration that is still referenced -- either as the type of the entry point's own (unread) parameter, or via a local variable's declaration/cast that is itself never subsequently read. Root-caused to VarReferenceVisitor only marking a type used via a later DeclRefExpr to an already-declared variable, never via the declaration/parameter itself (entryFnDecl->parameters() is never walked in this file's history); one root cause for both reported shapes, confirmed by used-vs-unused controls that flip the verdict identically for each.
title: Rewriter: entrypoint function's param referenced types are removed when param is not used.
